## tick outcome and descriptiev stat
```{r}
library(dplyr)

## Load data
data_dir <- "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/Alpha Gal Risk in Illinois/Data"

dat <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "LS_data.csv"))

## Create proportional outcome
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(LS_prop = ifelse(Total_tick > 0, LS_tick / Total_tick, NA_real_))

## Descriptive statistics function
get_desc <- function(x, name) {
  x_valid <- x[!is.na(x)]
  sw <- shapiro.test(x_valid)

  data.frame(
    Variable = name,
    Total_counties = length(x),
    Valid_counties = length(x_valid),
    Missing_counties = sum(is.na(x)),
    Mean = mean(x_valid),
    SD = sd(x_valid),
    Median = median(x_valid),
    Q1 = quantile(x_valid, 0.25),
    Q3 = quantile(x_valid, 0.75),
    IQR = IQR(x_valid),
    Minimum = min(x_valid),
    Maximum = max(x_valid),
    Zero_counties = sum(x_valid == 0),
    Shapiro_W = unname(sw$statistic),
    Shapiro_p = sw$p.value
  )
}

## Raw count and proportional outcome
desc <- bind_rows(
  get_desc(dat$LS_tick, "Lone star tick count"),
  get_desc(dat$LS_prop, "Lone star tick proportion")
)

print(desc)

## Save output
out_dir <- "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/Alpha Gal Risk in Illinois/Output"
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

write.csv(
  desc,
  file.path(out_dir, "descriptive_lone_star_outcomes.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

```


##Mapping outcoem
```{r}
library(sf); library(dplyr); library(ggplot2); library(viridis); library(scales)

## Load data and shapefile
data_dir <- "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/Alpha Gal Risk in Illinois/Data"
dat <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "LS_data.csv")) %>% mutate(LS_prop = ifelse(Total_tick > 0, LS_tick / Total_tick, NA_real_))

shp <- st_read("C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/Bayesian Spatial Modeling (Illinois)/Illinois Shape File/Shape file of interest/IL_BNDY_County_Py.shp", quiet=TRUE)

## Merge
dat <- dat %>% mutate(county_key=tolower(gsub("[[:space:]]+","",trimws(COUNTY))))
shp <- shp %>% mutate(county_key=tolower(gsub("[[:space:]]+","",trimws(COUNTY_NAM))))
map <- left_join(shp, dat, by="county_key")

## Map lone star tick proportion
## Illinois outer boundary
il_boundary <- sf::st_union(map)

fig <- ggplot(map) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = LS_prop), color = "grey45", linewidth = 0.18) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c("white", viridis::plasma(100)),
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1),
    na.value = "grey85",
    name = "Proportion"
  ) +
  coord_sf(datum = NA, expand = TRUE) +
  theme_void(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
    plot.margin = margin(12, 12, 12, 12)
  )

fig

## Save
out_dir <- "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/Alpha Gal Risk in Illinois/Output"
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "lone_star_tick_proportion_map.tiff"), fig,
       width=6, height=8, dpi=300, compression="lzw", bg="white")
```
